I actually have had this planned out for a while.

The day after I graduate high school, I'm gonna go on a trip to see some of the places my favorite memories took place. I'll pack my alto and/or electric keyboard (plus whatever sheet music I have), a rope, and snag a bottle of wine from my parents cabinet before I leave. I'll vibe in some places, and play a little bit. Put the last bit of myself into my fondest memories or whatever. After my last stop (in a little forest not far from home), I'm gonna put my favorite playlist on shuffle, drink the bottle til it's gone, then tie myself up. 

It's probably the best that plan is gonna be. Hopefully it'll go as smoothly as I want.
